title: Rings and Rods
goal: Count rods carrying at least one ring of every color.
strategy: Each rod needs only three presence bits. Repeated rings of an already present color leave the mask unchanged; mask seven means all three colors are present.

phasePurposes.start: Count rods carrying at least one ring of every color.
phasePurposes.inspect: Each rod needs only three presence bits. Repeated rings of an already present color leave the mask unchanged; mask seven means all three colors are present.
phasePurposes.update: Each rod needs only three presence bits. Repeated rings of an already present color leave the mask unchanged; mask seven means all three colors are present.
phasePurposes.done: Count rods carrying at least one ring of every color.

edgeCases: Repeating one color never completes a rod
All three colors reach different rods
One rod gets all colors in a different order
